text: The holy names of Nitāi and Gaura are the abode of bliss. Yama Mahārāja captures those who never utter these names and plunges them into the hellish planets.

text: This Locana dāsa always tells everyone to sing the glories of Śrī Śrī Gaura-Nitāi in great happiness. Those who have no attachment for this nectar have lime-paste and soot smeared on their faces [in disgrace].
